# 3. Run database migrations as a separate job

## Status

Proposed

## Context

The order service applies its database migrations when it starts. With three
instances starting at once they race to apply the same migration, and a slow
migration holds up the rollout of every instance. A failed migration leaves the
service crash looping with no clear message.

## Decision

We will run migrations as a job of their own before the rollout, with the same
image and the migration tool we already use. The rollout waits for the job, and a
failed job stops the rollout and alerts the team that owns the service.

## Consequences

Instances start faster and never race. The deployment pipeline gains a step, and
a migration has to be compatible with the version of the service still running
while it is applied.
